name: Destruction of Ukrainian Societies and Segregation (1906–1910) (C0050)

techniques.comment: The official classing of the indigenous population as aliens: Stolypin prescribed to the governors to refuse the registration of "any alien societies whatsoever, including Ukrainian and Jewish ones, regardless of the aims they pursue"(Citation: Столыпинский циркуляр 1910).

The direct closure of legal educational societies: of the roughly forty "Prosvitas" of Russian-ruled Ukraine, those in the Poltava and Kharkiv regions were banned from their very founding, and in 1908–1910, under Stolypin, virtually all the rest were liquidated, except the branches of the Katerynoslav governorate(Citation: Українська мова в першій половині двадцятого століття (1900-1941). Стан і статус 1987). The crackdown received its doctrinal grounding: Stolypin declared in an address to the Senate that the revival of Ukrainian cultural life was undesirable, for "the three principal branches of Eastern Slavdom, both by origin and by language, cannot but constitute one whole"(Citation: Українська мова в першій половині двадцятого століття (1900-1941). Стан і статус 1987).
Stolypin's circular to the governors (20 January 1910) — a complete ban on self-organization: "when considering petitions for the registration of any alien societies whatsoever… one must… refuse without fail the registration of their charters"(Citation: Столыпинский циркуляр 1910).
